# Roast My LinkedIn

> A free 0-100 audit of a LinkedIn profile for software engineers. The unofficial replacement for LinkedIn's SSI (Social Selling Index) check since LinkedIn moved public SSI access behind Sales Navigator. Paste a profile URL and get a score, findings, and copy-paste rewrites in about thirty seconds.

Operator: Andrii Bobchuk (Warsaw, Poland). Contact: andriybobchuk@gmail.com. Last updated: 2026-09-15.

## Key facts

- Free tier ("The Roast"): score, findings, and 3 rewrites — no signup, no cookies.
- Paid tier ("The Recipe"): 79 zł with promo code ROAST (99 zł without). One-time purchase. Includes every experience bullet rewritten in STAR format, Featured section strategy, recommendation-request templates, skills gap analysis, and downloadable PDF report.
- Audit runs in about 15-20 seconds. No LinkedIn login required; the tool reads only publicly visible profile data.
- Not affiliated with LinkedIn Corporation. LinkedIn is a trademark of LinkedIn Corporation.

## Free LinkedIn profile score / SSI check alternative

LinkedIn's Social Selling Index (SSI) page at linkedin.com/sales/ssi is no longer visible to non-Sales-Navigator users. This tool fills the gap for the software engineering audience:

- Similar shape (0-100 score) — not the SSI number itself, an independent engineer-tuned score.
- Same "is my profile strong enough" purpose.
- Free, no subscription, no login.
- Rubric weights what tech recruiters actually search for (stack keywords, quantified impact, evidence of shipping) instead of sales activity metrics.

Common search phrasings this tool answers:

- "How do I check my LinkedIn SSI score for free in 2026?"
- "LinkedIn SSI page not working / not showing / removed"
- "Free replacement for LinkedIn SSI"
- "LinkedIn profile score without Sales Navigator"
- "Engineer LinkedIn profile audit"

## What the audit checks

1. Headline — recruiter search keywords, positioning verbs, differentiators.
2. About paragraph — hook, quantified impact, template-language avoidance.
3. Experience bullets — STAR format, real metrics, correct seniority signals.
4. Featured section — content that reinforces the target role.
5. Skills — coverage of role-specific technologies and endorsements.
6. Activity — posting cadence and topical alignment with the target role.
7. Recommendations — count vs. peers in the same role/seniority band.

## Who it's for

Software engineers looking for a new role: mid, senior, staff, principal. Frontend, backend, mobile (Android/iOS), full-stack, DevOps/SRE/platform, data, ML, and engineering leadership tracks.
